description: Hey, quick summary of the cellar leak. A compression fitting on a wall-mounted pipe bend in the basement failed and released water into the surrounding wall and floor. The joint was sealed, the affected wall tiles were removed and replaced, the substrate was re-levelled, and drying equipment ran for around two weeks. Large-format tiles were used for the reinstatement. The invoices need checking: the drying bill includes an unexplained material surcharge, both the drying and tiling contractors charged for the same construction-waste disposal, and unrelated plaster removal in the attic was also carried out during the works. There were a couple of visits in total.
